We are looking for an experienced IT Manager to lead and continuously improve IT operations across Snoonu's corporate offices, warehouses, operational sites, and growing regional footprint.

You will lead the team responsible for ensuring our employees and operations have reliable, secure, and effective technology to do their best work—from IT service delivery and end-user support to endpoint management, employee technology lifecycle, IT assets, access operations, workplace technology, and site readiness.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines strong operational discipline, technical judgment, people leadership, and a genuine service mindset. We are looking for a leader who can keep critical services running today while continuously making IT more proactive, automated, scalable, and ready for tomorrow.
q: 4+ years of progressive experience in IT operations, IT service management, workplace technology, infrastructure support, or related areas, including people-management responsibility.
Proven experience leading IT operations or IT support teams in a complex, fast-moving environment.
Strong experience with IT service management, incident and request management, SLAs, escalation, problem management, and continuous service improvement.
Hands-on understanding of endpoint management, identity and access operations, employee technology lifecycle, enterprise SaaS, collaboration platforms, and workplace technology.
Experience managing IT assets across their full lifecycle, including inventory accuracy, procurement coordination, assignment, recovery, replacement, and disposal.
Experience supporting multiple offices, warehouses, operational sites, or geographically distributed teams.
Strong ability to use service metrics, operational data, and root-cause analysis to improve reliability and user experience.
Experience managing vendors, service providers, contracts, procurement, and IT costs.
Strong leadership skills and the ability to build accountability, develop people, manage capacity, and maintain high service standards.
Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical teams, business functions, and senior leadership.
A practical mindset and the ability to balance urgency, user needs, security, cost, and long-term scalability.
Experience in a high-growth technology, e-commerce, marketplace, logistics, retail, fintech, or super-app environment.
Experience supporting warehouses, dark stores, retail locations, or other operationally critical sites.
Experience supporting multi-country operations, rapid organizational growth, or new-market launches.

Experience with modern enterprise environments including Google Workspace, endpoint-management platforms such as Microsoft Intune, ITSM platforms such as Jira Service Management, SSO/IAM solutions, Slack, and enterprise SaaS applications.
Experience automating IT workflows and integrating HR, identity, ITSM, asset-management, and collaboration platforms.
Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent technology certifications.

Own the employee technology experience across onboarding, role changes, transfers, and offboarding, ensuring people have the right devices, accounts, software, and approved access at the right time.
Oversee endpoint and workplace technology, including laptops, mobile devices, peripherals, meeting-room technology, printing, and other employee-facing systems.
Own IT asset management throughout the full lifecycle—from procurement and assignment to recovery, repair, replacement, reuse, and secure disposal.

Expand automation and self-service across onboarding, offboarding, access requests, ticketing, asset management, reporting, and other high-volume IT workflows.

Manage IT vendors, service providers, technology procurement, licensing, and operational costs with a focus on service quality and sustainable value.
